narr: A series of mesoscale convective complexes developed over western portions of the Southern Plains and dived southeast through North and Central Texas, producing isolated instances of flooding and wind damage. On June 6th, a female died in her vehicle while crossing a flooded creek in Garland.
ev: Flood gates were closed along Naaman School Road between Brand Road and Miles Road, and between Pleasant Valley Road and Castle Road. Part of the road was inundated by the rising of Spring Creek that crosses the road.
Floodgates were closed at Campbell Road at Rowlett Creek.
A woman drowned after her car was surrounded by water while trying to cross Spring Creek on Holford Drive in Garland. Her car was swept downstream.
Flash flooding was reported at multiple intersections in Groesbeck. Up to two inches of rain fell in less than an hour.

CITY MANAGER REPORTS THAT 2 INCHES OF RAIN HAD FALLEN IN LAST 45 MINUTES OF REPORT TIME; FLASH FLOODING AT MULTIPLE INTERSECTIONS IN DOWNTOWN GROESBECK; POWER WAS LOST IN SEVERAL NEIGHBORHOODS.
